tldr: Treatment choice from confidential observational records depends on distinguishing the sign of a smooth causal contrast embedded in rough confounding functions. The focal object is the complete pure-private minimax welfare-regret frontier on the stipulated full-support, unknown-density, primitive-margin class. A single release of count-weighted causal cell moments supplies the attainment handle. Legal positive-background opposite-decision mixtures supply the converse handle. The rate, tuning and transitions are outputs of the open question; the contribution must distinguish observational nuisance costs from randomized classification and match every privacy branch.
gap: Bonvini, Kennedy and Keele study weighted causal level sets with a zero-excluding margin and design conditions for attainment. Kennedy et al. study pointwise CATE rates. Neither result supplies the stipulated full-class pure-private policy decision frontier. Private treatment-rule and orthogonal CATE methodology already exists.
fill: The complete-frontier question couples unknown-density attainment with legal decision-prior transport, then derives the sampling and privacy regimes in one fixed observation experiment. The target is a subfield contribution; generic private learning and the supervised branch receive no independent novelty credit.
